items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung beim Landkreis Musteruckermark – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: This is a formally served letter (Zustellungsurkunde per §182 ZPO), so the statutory deemed-delivery rules for ordinary post do not apply; the delivery date is the date written on the Zustellungsurkunde itself: 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the two-week period starts 25.11.2026. Under §188 Abs.1,2 BGB a period of weeks ends on the day of the second week that bears the same name as the day of the triggering event, i.e. the second following Tuesday: 08.12.2026. 08.12.2026 is a working day in Brandenburg (no weekend/holiday), so no shift applies. Note the letter requires the objection to actually 'vorliegen' (be received) at the Bußgeldstelle by this date, not merely be postmarked by then.

items.title: Pay the fine (Gesamtbetrag) once the Bescheid becomes final
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final). The Bescheid becomes final if no Einspruch is lodged within the objection period computed above, which ends 08.12.2026; Rechtskraft then occurs on the following day, 09.12.2026. Counting two weeks from there: under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day itself (09.12.2026) is not counted, and under §188 Abs.1,2 BGB the period ends on the corresponding weekday two weeks later: Wednesday 23.12.2026, which is a normal working day in Brandenburg, so no shift applies. This date only holds if NO Einspruch is filed by 08.12.2026; if an Einspruch is filed, the Bescheid is not yet final and this payment deadline does not start running on this schedule.

warnings: The printed IBAN DE92 1705 6060 0001 7291 00 fails the standard IBAN checksum check — verify it against an official source before paying, rather than trusting this letter alone.

The sender's email domain ('landkreis-musteruckermark-bu.example') and place names (Musteruckermark, Musterprenzlau, Beispielkow) use the reserved '.example' placeholder domain and obviously fictitious place names, suggesting this document is a template/sample rather than a genuine official notice — do not act on it as if it were a real Bußgeldbescheid without confirming with the actual Landkreis.
The payment due date (23.12.2026) is only valid if no Einspruch is filed by 08.12.2026; filing an objection changes the payment timeline entirely.
